license_required.quote: No person shall engage in the practice of nursing, as defined in Section 2725, without holding a license that is in an active status issued under this chapter except as otherwise provided in this act.

age_minimum.quote: An applicant for a vocational nurse license shall comply with each of the following: (a) Be at least 17 years of age.

degree_required.value: Approved school of nursing program covering not fewer than two academic years, at an institution of higher education including community colleges offering associate degrees and postsecondary institutions offering associate, baccalaureate, or entry-level master's degree
degree_required.quote: An approved school of nursing, or an approved nursing program, is one that has been approved by the board, gives the course of instruction approved by the board, covering not fewer than two academic years, is affiliated or conducted in connection with one or more hospitals, and is an institution of higher education.

accrediting_body.quote: An approved school of nursing, or an approved nursing program, is one that has been approved by the board

degree_level.quote: community colleges offering an associate of arts or associate of science degree and private postsecondary institutions offering an associate of arts, associate of science, or baccalaureate degree or an entry-level master's degree

school_approval_basis.quote: An approved school of nursing, or an approved nursing program, is one that has been approved by the board

credential_pegged.quote: Have successfully completed the courses of instruction prescribed by the board for licensure, in a program in this state approved by the board for training registered nurses

tiers.quote: community colleges offering an associate of arts or associate of science degree and private postsecondary institutions offering an associate of arts, associate of science, or baccalaureate degree or an entry-level master's degree

tiers.license_class: nurse practitioner (initial qualification on or after January 1, 2008)
tiers.quote: Possess a master's degree in nursing, a master's degree in a clinical field related to nursing, or a graduate degree in nursing.
Have successfully completed at least an approved course of study through the 12th grade or the equivalent thereof as specified by the board.
Possession of a master's degree in a clinical field of nursing.

required.quote: Has completed a transition to practice in California of a minimum of three full-time equivalent years of practice or 4600 hours.

experience_source.quote: Has completed a transition to practice in California of a minimum of three full-time equivalent years of practice or 4600 hours.

duration.quote: Has completed a transition to practice in California of a minimum of three full-time equivalent years of practice or 4600 hours.

kind.value: transition to practice (for nurse practitioners seeking independent practice authority)
kind.quote: "Transition to practice" means additional clinical experience and mentorship provided to prepare a nurse practitioner to practice independently.

exams.name: NCLEX-RN (or board-prescribed examination)
exams.notes: Board prescribes the examination; applicants from foreign countries must pass the board's examination.
exams.quote: An applicant who has received their training from a school of nursing in a country outside the United States and who has complied with subdivision (a), or has completed training equivalent to that required by subdivision (a), shall qualify for licensure by successfully passing the examination prescribed by the board.

exams.name: National nurse practitioner board certification examination
exams.notes: Required for NPs seeking independent practice authority under Section 2837.103; must be from a body accredited by NCCA or ABNS and recognized by the board.
exams.quote: Passed a national nurse practitioner board certification examination and, if applicable, any supplemental examination developed pursuant to paragraph (4) of subdivision (a) of Section 2837.105.

exams.name: LVN licensure examination
exams.notes: Written examination; may be supplemented by oral or practical examination.
exams.quote: Any applicant who fails to pass the first examination may take a second examination upon payment of the fee required by this chapter.

interval_years.quote: Each person holding a regular renewable license under this chapter, whether in an active or inactive status, shall apply for a renewal of their license and pay the biennial renewal fee required by this chapter every two years

required.quote: Each person renewing their license under Section 2811 shall submit proof satisfactory to the board that, during the preceding two-year period, they have been informed of the developments in the registered nurse field or in any special area of practice engaged in by the licensee

hours_per_period.quote: The continuing education standards established by the board shall not exceed 30 hours of direct participation in a course or courses approved by the board, or its equivalent in the units of measure adopted by the board.

period_years.quote: Each person renewing their license under Section 2811 shall submit proof satisfactory to the board that, during the preceding two-year period, they have been informed of the developments in the registered nurse field

value: implicit bias (1 hour for new licensees in first 2 years)
Schedule II controlled substances and addiction risks (for NPs/CNMs with DEA numbers furnishing Schedule II substances)
topical_requirements.quote: beginning January 1, 2023, those licensees shall complete one hour of direct participation in an implicit bias course offered by a continuing education provider approved by the board

available.quote: the board may issue a license without examination to any applicant who is licensed or registered as a nurse in a state, district, or territory of the United States or Canada having, in the opinion of the board, requirements for licensing or registration equal to or higher than those in California at the time the application is filed

requirements.quote: the board may issue a license without examination to any applicant who is licensed or registered as a nurse in a state, district, or territory of the United States or Canada having, in the opinion of the board, requirements for licensing or registration equal to or higher than those in California at the time the application is filed with the Board of Registered Nursing, if they have passed an examination for the license or registration that is, in the board's opinion, comparable to the board's examination, and if they meet all the other requirements set forth in Section 2736.

exists.quote: The board shall establish a Nurse Practitioner Advisory Committee to advise and make recommendations to the board on all matters relating to nurse practitioners, including, but not limited to, education, appropriate standard of care, and other matters specified by the board.

name.value: Nurse Practitioner Advisory Committee; Nurse-Midwifery Advisory Committee; Nursing Education and Workforce Advisory Committee
name.quote: The board shall establish a Nurse Practitioner Advisory Committee to advise and make recommendations to the board on all matters relating to nurse practitioners

authority.value: Advisory — makes recommendations to the board on education, standard of care, and other matters; provides recommendations or guidance when board is considering disciplinary action
authority.quote: The committee shall make recommendations to the board on all matters related to midwifery practice, education, appropriate standard of care, and other matters as specified by the board. The committee shall provide recommendations or guidance on care when the board is considering disciplinary action against a certified nurse-midwife.

national_certification.value: National Board of Certification and Recertification for Nurse Anesthetists; National Commission for Certifying Agencies (NCCA); American Board of Nursing Specialties (ABNS)
national_certification.quote: the board shall consider the standards of the National Board of Certification and Recertification for Nurse Anesthetists, or a successor national professional organization approved by the board

national_association.value: American College of Nurse-Midwives; National Organization of Nurse Practitioner Faculties; Council on Accreditation of Nurse Anesthesia Education Programs and Schools
national_association.quote: consistent with the Core Competencies for Basic Midwifery Practice adopted by the American College of Nurse-Midwives, or its successor national professional organization, as approved by the board

regulatory_model.quote: No person shall engage in the practice of nursing, as defined in Section 2725, without holding a license that is in an active status issued under this chapter except as otherwise provided in this act.

credential_type.quote: No person shall engage in the practice of nursing, as defined in Section 2725, without holding a license that is in an active status issued under this chapter except as otherwise provided in this act.

is_mandatory.quote: No person shall engage in the practice of nursing, as defined in Section 2725, without holding a license that is in an active status issued under this chapter except as otherwise provided in this act.

title_protection.quote: It is unlawful for any person or persons not licensed or certified as provided in this chapter to use the title "registered nurse," the letters "R.N. ," or the words "graduate nurse," "trained nurse," or "nurse anesthetist."

scope_protection.quote: No person shall engage in the practice of nursing, as defined in Section 2725, without holding a license that is in an active status issued under this chapter except as otherwise provided in this act.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Incompetence or gross negligence in carrying out usual certified or licensed nursing functions
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Incompetence or gross negligence in carrying out usual certified or licensed nursing functions.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction of practicing medicine without a license
disciplinary_grounds.quote: A conviction of practicing medicine without a license in violation of Chapter 5 (commencing with Section 2000), in which event the record of conviction shall be conclusive evidence thereof.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Use of advertising relating to nursing that violates Section 17500
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The use of advertising relating to nursing that violates Section 17500.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Denial of licensure, revocation, suspension, restriction, or other disciplinary action by another state or government agency
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Denial of licensure, revocation, suspension, restriction, or any other disciplinary action against a health care professional license or certificate by another state or territory of the United States, by any other government agency, or by another California health care professional licensing board.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Procuring a certificate or license by fraud, misrepresentation, or mistake
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Procuring their certificate or license by fraud, misrepresentation, or mistake.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Procuring, aiding, or abetting a criminal abortion
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Procuring, or aiding, or abetting, or attempting, or agreeing, or offering to procure or assist at a criminal abortion.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violating or conspiring to violate any provision of this chapter or adopted regulations
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violating or attempting to violate, directly or indirectly, or assisting in or abetting the violating of, or conspiring to violate any provision or term of this chapter or regulations adopted pursuant to it.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Making or giving any false statement or information in connection with application for license or certificate
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Making or giving any false statement or information in connection with the application for issuance of a certificate or license.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction of a felony or of any offense substantially related to nursing qualifications, functions, or duties
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Conviction of a felony or of any offense substantially related to the qualifications, functions, and duties of a registered nurse, in which event the record of the conviction shall be conclusive evidence thereof.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Impersonating any applicant or acting as proxy for an applicant in a required examination
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Impersonating any applicant or acting as proxy for an applicant in any examination required under this chapter for the issuance of a certificate or license.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Impersonating another certified or licensed practitioner, or allowing another to use one's certificate or license
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Impersonating another certified or licensed practitioner, or permitting or allowing another person to use their certificate or license for the purpose of nursing the sick or afflicted.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Aiding or assisting any person in violating provisions of Article 12 of Chapter 5
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Aiding or assisting, or agreeing to aid or assist any person or persons, whether a licensed physician or not, in the performance of, or arranging for, a violation of any of the provisions of Article 12 (commencing with Section 2220) of Chapter 5.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Holding oneself out as a nurse practitioner or other advanced practice title without meeting board standards
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Holding oneself out to the public or to any practitioner of the healing arts as a nurse practitioner or as meeting the standards established by the board for a nurse practitioner unless meeting the standards established by the board pursuant to Article 8 (commencing with Section 2834) or holding oneself out to the public as being certified by the board as a nurse anesthetist, nurse midwife, clinical nurse specialist, or public health nurse unless the person is at the time certified by the board.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Knowing failure to follow infection control guidelines, risking transmission of blood-borne infectious diseases
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Except for good cause, the knowing failure to protect patients by failing to follow infection control guidelines of the board, thereby risking transmission of blood-borne infectious diseases from licensed or certified nurse to patient, from patient to patient, and from patient to licensed or certified nurse.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Unlawful obtaining, possessing, or administering controlled substances or dangerous drugs; impaired practice due to substance use
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Obtain or possess in violation of law, or prescribe, or except as directed by a licensed physician and surgeon, dentist, or podiatrist administer to themselves, or furnish or administer to another, any controlled substance as defined in Division 10 (commencing with Section 11000) of the Health and Safety Code or any dangerous drug or dangerous device as defined in Section 4022.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Falsifying or making grossly incorrect entries in hospital, patient, or other records pertaining to controlled substances
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Falsify, or make grossly incorrect, grossly inconsistent, or unintelligible entries in any hospital, patient, or other record pertaining to the substances described in subdivision (a) of this section.

insurance_required.quote: A nurse practitioner practicing under this section shall have professional liability insurance appropriate for the practice setting.

definition_quote.value: The practice of nursing within the meaning of this chapter means those functions, including basic health care, that help people cope with difficulties in daily living that are associated with their actual or potential health or illness problems or the treatment thereof, and that require a substantial amount of scientific knowledge or technical skill
definition_quote.quote: The practice of nursing within the meaning of this chapter means those functions, including basic health care, that help people cope with difficulties in daily living that are associated with their actual or potential health or illness problems or the treatment thereof, and that require a substantial amount of scientific knowledge or technical skill

value: Direct and indirect patient care services ensuring safety, comfort, personal hygiene, and protection of patients; disease prevention and restorative measures

Administration of medications and therapeutic agents necessary to implement a treatment, disease prevention, or rehabilitative regimen ordered by and within scope of licensure of a physician, dentist, podiatrist, or clinical psychologist
Performance of skin tests, immunization techniques, and withdrawal of human blood from veins and arteries

Observation of signs and symptoms of illness, reactions to treatment, general behavior, general physical condition; determination of abnormal characteristics; implementation of reporting, referral, standardized procedures, or emergency procedures
methods_authorized.quote: Direct and indirect patient care services that ensure the safety, comfort, personal hygiene, and protection of patients; and the performance of disease prevention and restorative measures.

drug_authority.value: RNs may dispense drugs upon order of licensed physician and surgeon or order by a certified nurse-midwife, nurse practitioner, or physician assistant in licensed primary care clinics. NPs with a furnishing number may prescribe, administer, dispense, and furnish pharmacological agents including controlled substances (Schedule II-V) pursuant to standardized procedures or, for qualifying NPs under Section 2837.103/2837.104, without standardized procedures. CNMs with a furnishing number may furnish or order drugs including Schedule II-V controlled substances incidental to their scope of practice. CRNAs may select and administer medication including controlled substances pursuant to an order for anesthesia services by a physician, dentist, or podiatrist.
drug_authority.quote: Prescribe, administer, dispense, and furnish pharmacological agents, including over-the-counter, legend, and controlled substances.

value: Nurse Practitioner with full independent practice (Section 2837.104 certificate)
license_tiers.quote: board-issued certification includes, but is not limited to, certification as a nurse practitioner, nurse practitioner with a furnishing number, nurse anesthetist, nurse midwife, nurse midwife with a furnishing number, public health nurse, clinical nurse specialist, or board listed psychiatric mental health nurse.

aprn_role_categories.quote: "Advanced practice registered nurse" means those licensed registered nurses who have met the requirements of Article 2.5 (commencing with Section 2746), Article 7 (commencing with Section 2825), Article 8 (commencing with Section 2834), or Article 9 (commencing with Section 2838).

value: Naturopathic doctor (within naturopathic doctor's scope of practice)
lpn_supervision_requirements.quote: The practice of vocational nursing within the meaning of this chapter is the performance of services requiring those technical, manual skills acquired by means of a course in an approved school of vocational nursing, or its equivalent, practiced under the direction of a licensed physician and surgeon or registered nurse, as defined in Section 2725, or naturopathic doctor

collaborative_practice_agreement_require.quote: pursuant to policies and protocols that are mutually agreed upon by a physician and surgeon, that delineate the parameters for consultation, collaboration, referral, and transfer of a patient's care, and that are signed by both the certified nurse-midwife and a physician and surgeon

full_independent_practice_available.quote: Beginning January 1, 2023, notwithstanding any other law, the following apply to a nurse practitioner who holds an active certification issued by the board pursuant to subdivision (b): (1) The nurse practitioner may perform the functions specified in subdivision (c) of Section 2837.103 pursuant to that subdivision outside of the settings or organizations specified under subparagraphs (A) to (F)

full_independent_practice_experience_hou.quote: Has completed a transition to practice in California of a minimum of three full-time equivalent years of practice or 4600 hours.

prescriptive_authority_certificate_requi.quote: The furnishing or ordering of drugs or devices by a certified nurse-midwife is conditional on the issuance by the board of a number to the applicant who has successfully completed the requirements of paragraph (2).

controlled_substance_schedule_authority.quote: Drugs or devices furnished or ordered by a nurse practitioner may include Schedule II through Schedule V controlled substances under the California Uniform Controlled Substances Act

dea_registration_required.quote: Every certified nurse-midwife who is authorized pursuant to this section to furnish or issue a drug order for a controlled substance shall register with the United States Drug Enforcement Administration and the Controlled Substance Utilization Review and Enforcement System (CURES)

controlled_substance_database_registrati.quote: Every certified nurse-midwife who is authorized pursuant to this section to furnish or issue a drug order for a controlled substance shall register with the United States Drug Enforcement Administration and the Controlled Substance Utilization Review and Enforcement System (CURES) pursuant to Section 11165.1 of the Health and Safety Code.

delegation_to_unlicensed_personnel_autho.quote: A health facility licensed pursuant to subdivision (a), (b), or (f), of Section 1250 of the Health and Safety Code shall not assign unlicensed personnel to perform nursing functions in lieu of a registered nurse and may not allow unlicensed personnel to perform functions under the direct clinical supervision of a registered nurse that require a substantial amount of scientific knowledge and technical skills

employer_mandatory_reporting_required.quote: Any employer of a licensed vocational nurse shall report to the board the suspension or termination for cause, or resignation for cause, of any licensed vocational nurse in its employ.

impaired_nurse_alternative_program_avail.quote: It is the intent of the Legislature that the Board of Registered Nursing shall implement this legislation by establishing an intervention program as a voluntary alternative to traditional disciplinary actions.

approximate.matched_normalized: the intent of the legislature that the board of registered nursing shall implement this legislation by establishing an intervention program as a voluntary alternative to traditional disciplinary actions

public_health_nurse_certification_availa.quote: No individual shall hold himself or herself out as a public health nurse or use a title which includes the term "public health nurse" unless that individual is in possession of a valid California public health nurse certificate issued pursuant to this article.

nurse_practitioner_transition_to_practic.quote: Has completed a transition to practice in California of a minimum of three full-time equivalent years of practice or 4600 hours.

crna_physician_supervision_model.quote: The utilization of a nurse anesthetist to provide anesthesia services in an acute care facility shall be approved by the acute care facility administration and the appropriate committee, and at the discretion of the physician, dentist or podiatrist.

cnm_out_of_hospital_birth_authorized.quote: The certificate to practice nurse-midwifery authorizes the holder to attend pregnancy and childbirth in an out-of-hospital setting if consistent with subdivisions (a), (b), and (c).

aprn_formulary_or_protocol_required.quote: The drugs or devices are furnished or ordered by a nurse practitioner in accordance with standardized procedures or protocols developed by the nurse practitioner and the supervising physician and surgeon

nursing_education_program_clinical_hours.quote: An approved school of nursing or nursing program shall meet a minimum of 500 direct patient care clinical hours in a board-approved clinical setting with a minimum of 30 hours of supervised direct patient care clinical hours dedicated to each nursing area specified by the board.

implicit_bias_training_required_in_curri.quote: Graduation requirements for an approved school of nursing, or an approved nursing program, shall include one hour of direct participation in an implicit bias training

military_education_credit_required.quote: The board shall deny the application for approval made by, and shall revoke the approval given to, any school of nursing that does not give student applicants credit in the field of nursing for military education and experience by the use of challenge examinations or other methods of evaluation.
